title: The Painted Pebble in the Sun
youtube_title: The Painted Pebble in the Sun | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets a small thing finish its quiet work.
summary: At a bakery kitchen where dough and jam are left to finish, Brisa wants to check on a painted pebble left in a square of sun before it is ready. With Mama nearby, Brisa leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
